basic_profile.bio: Originally from sunny California, I've recently moved to Ohio to start my freshman year at Kent State University, pursuing a degree in Environmental Science. I'm a curious soul, always looking to explore new ideas and hobbies, which is why I love the endless rabbit holes on Reddit. My interests range from gaming—particularly playing as Jayce in League of Legends—to collecting vinyl records. I also dabble in network security as a hobby. On weekends, I enjoy exploring the local scene in Sonoma County. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after classes and on weekends. I’m single and enjoy my independence and the freedom to explore new interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a budding interest in environmental science, which I’m studying at university. My knowledge is mostly academic, supplemented by online courses and a lot of self-study. I’ve also recently become interested in network security, which led me to explore tools like pfBlockerNG.
